page.layout: One printed page (left page, p. 156). One wide text column, with a blank narrow column on the left that holds no text. Notes: none beside the column. The right edge shows the neighbouring page, which is not transcribed.

main_text.l: De vindicta diuina in Maximum, Grati-
latus est. Gratiani necem ita perpetra-
cum Theodosium viderent oculis ad parcen-dum

marginalia.note: Maximus ab infensis Gratiano Militibus & Legionibus exceptus, eundem subita incursione perterritum, atque in Italiam transire cupientem, dolis circumuentū, per manus Andragathij Classis Praefecti interemit; sed verte folium, & sequenti pagina videbis hunc ipsum Maximum à suis Militibus apprehensum, vinctum, & Theodosio traditum ;

page.notes: The left-hand column is blank. The right edge shows part of the facing page (LIB. III, p. 157), which is not transcribed. The running head "Scutum Regium" is read as "Scutum"; the printed form is slightly uncertain. The first letter of "Argobastis" is unclear in the scan; the reading is taken from the word's form. The bracketed passage is set inside the column with a bracket mark and is treated as a side note; its exact placement is uncertain. The last word of the page is "dum" printed on its own line, read as the end of "parcen-dum".
